site.name: Waypoint Relief
site.tagline: Direct field logistics for emergency aid

hero.headline: Urgent life-saving relief for displaced families in Gaza
hero.subhead: Waypoint Relief operates last-mile supply corridors to deliver food parcels, clean drinking water, medical supplies, and emergency shelter kits directly to families in need—verified and tracked on a public ledger.

ledger.title: Gaza Relief Supply Ledger
ledger.subtitle: Essential supply units delivered during this operational cycle, verified upon entry.

process.detail: On-the-ground teams log immediate family needs across distribution hubs every morning.
Aid convoys assemble verified supply manifests and time-stamp entries before deployment.
Logistics teams monitor movement through designated transit points with real-time logging.
Local partner staff confirm direct handoffs to families, closing the manifest entry.
